verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's CLI can be run "through an automated system" to execute collection tests and "manage automated API monitoring," and it produces JUnit reports for CI. That makes unattended, background runs possible, but only through an external scheduler or CI pipeline rather than built-in autonomous automations. Missing for 10: native scheduling or background job runner, built-in monitors or triggers, agent-driven autonomous workflows inside the product, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
